name: Salesforce (Agentforce)
positioning: Agentforce as the digital workforce on Customer 360 / Sales Cloud: out-of-the-box and job-ready sales agents (prospecting, engagement, pipeline, quoting, inbound pipe gen, outbound Hunter) plus long-horizon runtime for multi-day/week goals. Account Discovery Agent reads CRM data to summarize accounts/opportunities and flag who on the buying committee is engaging or going dark, shared view for sales and marketing (GA Oct '26). Campaign Agent: Agentic Campaigns GA now; Agentic Content across Email/SMS/RCS/MMS. recent.title: Opens talks with partners over agentic MCP/API billing
recent.summary: Salesforce Ben (Oct 21): after LinkedIn backlash over charging Flex Credits per Headless Platform Interaction (every successful registered-agent call over MCP or API), senior Salesforce stakeholders contacted architect/ISV-SI owner Amnon Kruvi. Asks: predictable agent pricing, value beyond plain MCP, room for AI-assisted org setup/support, AppExchange partner billing control. Multiplier still TBA; 30 days' notice before metering; sandboxes/dev orgs not metered; existing API agents migrate at renewal (Help article).

recent.title: Newsroom: 'From Autonomy to Accountability' — zero-trust view of multi-agent systems (white paper)
recent.summary: Oct 7 post by Kathy Baxter summarizing a white paper from workshops with 21 organizations: agents from third parties will act across company lines, so every interaction needs explicit, continuous verification (Zero Trust). Recommends deterministic guardrails outside the agent's reasoning loop (cites an NVIDIA study on thought-action disconnect), an 'owner's tag' on every memory item so memory isn't shared across users/agents, and defined human escalation points (large financial transactions, low confidence, prompt injection, failure loops). Thought leadership, not a launch.

recent.title: Newsroom Q&A: governed autonomy — LLM layer plus deterministic layer (Agent Fabric, Flow, Apex)
recent.summary: Oct 6 newsroom Q&A with Kathy Baxter (Principal Architect, Ethical AI Practice): Agentforce 'splits the agent brain into two layers' — probabilistic LLM for language/reasoning; consequential decisions routed through deterministic business logic, workflows and permissions with escalation to humans; audit trail of agent and human actions; Atlas Reasoning Engine explains actions; autonomy granted incrementally by policy; agents must identify as AI; Trust Layer toxicity and prompt-injection detection; Testing Center for bias checks; biggest gap cited is lack of post-launch monitoring. Messaging, not a launch.

Exploring OpenShell + MuleSoft Agent Fabric. Same day as NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform launch naming Salesforce among partners.

recent.title: SalesBleed: Zenity discloses patched Agentforce 0-click CRM exfil / Slack phishing flaws
recent.summary: Zenity Labs public write-up dated Sep 24, 2026 (also The Register same day): three Agentforce issues (indirect prompt injection via Web-to-Lead → Trusted URLs bypass → DNS/HTML-img or Slack-unfurl exfil; plus Slack Reply-to-Thread phishing under agent identity). Reported Jun 1; Trusted URLs fix confirmed Aug 19; Zenity says all three fixed as of Sep 21. No evidence of real-world exploitation stated. Companion: https://www.theregister.com/security/2026/09/24/salesforce-agentforce-vulns-allowed-0-click-crm-data-theft-anonymous-phishing/5298958
